text.arabic_uthmani: إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ

words.gloss_range: open conditional particle governing the will clause and both response verbs without fixing expected timing
words.prose: {{ar:إِن}} ({{tr:in}}) makes the ayah begin inside sovereign possibility: removal and replacement are not independent predictions, but the governed answer to a single condition. The tiny fixed particle controls the three clipped verbal beats that follow, so the sentence turns human dependence from the previous ayah into a compact enacted scenario of will, removal, bringing, and fresh creation rather than a scheduled forecast. Its opening scope also keeps the whole movement tied to will, not to decay, chance, or rival agency, and the quick opening beats give way to the heavier final replacement phrase.

topics.headline: one condition governs both outcomes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that removal and replacement are one governed conditional scenario, not two loose assertions.
topics.reason: The QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:إِن}} ({{tr:in}}) as governing the jussive protasis and both apodotic verbs.

topics.headline: compressed replacement scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's argument arriving as a tight sequence of will, removal, bringing, and fresh creation.
topics.reason: The local clause order supports the CRITICAL claim that the verse compresses sovereignty, vulnerability, and creative surplus into one ordered scene.

topics.headline: abrupt opening cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the quick opening beats giving way to the heavier final replacement phrase.
topics.reason: The sound rows add a modest but coherent cadence payoff tied to the conditional opening and the ayah's movement toward final heaviness.

words.gloss_range: conditional divine willing whose unspoken object is supplied by the following removal-and-replacement sequence
words.root_gloss_range: root field joining willing with determinate thingness; locally the objectless jussive lets the following apodosis specify the willed content
words.prose: {{ar:يَشَأْ}} ({{tr:yashaʾ}}) is the protasis verb, clipped by the condition and carrying an implicit singular divine subject. Its object is deliberately unspoken, so the reader does not receive a named thing willed before the sentence unfolds; the content appears only as the addressees' removal and the bringing of a new creation. The root's thingness pressure survives as realized content, while the local grammar keeps that content inside the following apodosis rather than turning the verb into vague desire.

topics.headline: will as conditional protasis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine will is the condition crossed before removal and replacement can be heard.
topics.reason: The verb is parsed as a jussive protasis after {{ar:إِن}} ({{tr:in}}), with an implicit 3ms subject supplied by the discourse.

topics.headline: unspoken object becomes the whole scenario
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of willing is delayed until the apodosis reveals removal plus replacement as one content.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence marks the frame as objectless, and the following apodotic verbs supply the scenario without requiring an invented object.

topics.headline: will moves toward realized content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the unspoken will is not empty; it is made concrete by the removal and new creation that follow.
topics.reason: The root-pressure claim is kept as content-realization pressure, while local grammar prevents treating any independent object as already named inside the verb.

topics.headline: will tied to removal, arrival, and creation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that familiar divine-will language is locally specialized into a replacement chain rather than left as general doctrine.
topics.reason: The cooccurrence and same-surah rows support a replacement field, and the local order directly binds will to removal, arrival, and creation.

topics.headline: clipped jussive cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the short dependent verb beats compressing the ayah's sovereignty claim.
topics.reason: The cadence rows cohere with the jussive chain and add audible compression without changing the lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: causative removal of the addressed plural as direct object, under the condition of divine will
words.root_gloss_range: root field of going away, disappearance, loss, and removal; locally Form IV with an attached object selects imposed removal rather than the addressees' own travel
words.prose: {{ar:يُذْهِبْكُمْ}} ({{tr:yudhhibkum}}) fuses the removal verb with the addressed plural object, so the people carried over from 35:15 become the removable object on the surface itself. Form IV turns going away into imposed disappearance: the addressees do not depart by their own momentum, but are made absent under the same condition of will. The clipped consonant texture before the heavy object suffix makes the imposed departure feel abrupt and object-directed. Because the next verb brings an alternative creation, this removal is not mere emptiness; it is the middle beat that clears the scene for replacement.

topics.headline: known addressees made removable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressed people from 35:15 are not abstractly discussed; they are grammatically fused to the removal verb.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence marks the suffix as the direct object and links it to the addressed people from the prior ayah.

topics.headline: going becomes imposed disappearance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement root narrowed by Form IV into caused removal rather than ordinary travel.
topics.reason: The broader going-away field survives as disappearance pressure, while Form IV and the object suffix select imposed removal in this frame.

topics.headline: removal answered by bringing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that disappearance is framed as transition toward replacement, not as the final state of the ayah.
topics.reason: The removal clause is followed by a coordinated bringing clause, and the CRITICAL intertext rows preserve the removal-to-replacement pattern.

topics.headline: abrupt object-directed texture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a clipped surface that fits the imposed, object-directed removal.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is modest but locally tied to the fused verb-object form.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction linking the bringing clause to the removal clause inside the same conditional response
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the hinge that keeps the ayah from stopping at removal. It coordinates the bringing verb with the completed removal clause under the same condition, without adding the causality of a different connector or a delayed sequence. Because the conjunction is prefixed onto the arrival verb, the second act enters visibly linked before it is parsed, so the sentence pivots from disappearance toward creative surplus rather than reopening as an afterthought.

topics.headline: second outcome kept under one condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that bringing a new creation remains coextensive with the same will-conditioned response as removal.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the following verb coordinated with the removal apodosis inside the same conditional frame.

topics.headline: arrival enters already linked
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the second verb entering as a visibly linked segment rather than as a stand-alone restart.
topics.reason: The conjunction is orthographically prefixed to the next verb and structurally performs the link between two apodosis actions.

topics.headline: pivot from disappearance to arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sentence pivoting from the addressees' disappearance toward creative surplus.
topics.reason: The conjunction sits between the removal and bringing verbs, preserving a balanced movement from subtraction to replacement.

words.gloss_range: conditioned bringing or causing-to-arrive with a governed bāʾ complement after removal
words.root_gloss_range: root field of coming, arrival, reaching, bringing, and production; locally the bāʾ construction presents the replacement as something brought into view
words.prose: {{ar:يَأْتِ}} ({{tr:yaʾti}}) is not a bare arrival verb here; with the following bāʾ complement it means bringing a replacement into presence. It shares the same implicit divine subject and remains clipped inside the conditional response, so arrival is the second act released by the opening will. The exact replacement formula appears at 14:19, and here it is applied directly after the addressed humans have been made removable; the same-surah create-bring test of rival incapacity at 35:40 sharpens the contrast with divine production.

topics.headline: arrival as bringing into presence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the replacement is brought into the scene, not merely named after the removal.
topics.reason: The local verb instance takes a bāʾ complement, supporting the brought-entity reading of the arrival root.

topics.headline: second act under the same condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that bringing the new creation is dependent on the same conditional will as removal.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the verb as coordinated with the prior apodosis and sharing the same implicit subject.

topics.headline: formula of creative replacement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a recognizable creative-replacement phrase being turned toward the present addressees.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete parallels at 14:19 and 35:40, while the local wording places the formula after human removal.

topics.headline: third beat resolves removal into replacement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the chain's final verb redirects the threat from loss to inexhaustible creative agency.
topics.reason: The verb occupies the final verbal position in the chain and semantically answers the removal verb.

words.gloss_range: preposition governing the creation phrase as the complement of the bringing verb
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is the small hinge that turns arrival into bringing-with. It governs the creation noun as a genitive complement, so the replacement does not stand as an isolated subject or a bare direct object. Because the preposition is prefixed to the noun, that dependency is visible and audible at the start of the replacement phrase. Its attachment range supports the sense of a brought entity, while the local construction keeps that range inside the specific arrival frame.

topics.headline: creation governed as complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the new creation enters as the governed complement of bringing, not as a detached nominal afterthought.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the preposition as governing the following noun and completing the bringing frame.

topics.headline: attachment range inside arrival frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices means, accompaniment, and attachment pressure supporting the brought-entity reading without making the preposition free-floating.
topics.reason: The semantic range is preserved as local attachment pressure, narrowed by the construction with the arrival verb.

topics.headline: short particle marks complement onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the replacement phrase audibly and visually beginning as a bound complement.
topics.reason: The surface rows show the preposition prefixed to the noun and paired with the earlier conjunction as a short articulating particle.

words.gloss_range: indefinite formed creation or created order brought as replacement and completed by the following newness adjective
words.root_gloss_range: root field of measuring, shaping, forming, creating, creaturely product, and formed constitution; locally the verbal noun allows act, product, and order to converge as an unnamed replacement
words.prose: {{ar:خَلْقٍۢ}} ({{tr:khalqin}}) names the replacement without identifying it. Its indefiniteness lets an unnamed formed order stand over against the known addressees, and its verbal-noun shape can hold both the creative act and the created result. The root pressure of measuring and shaping makes the replacement a deliberately formed order, while the constitution branch adds formed-disposition pressure without replacing the local creation sense. The following adjective completes the phrase as new. The recurring new-creation phrase also appears in resurrection dispute at 50:15, but here it is turned into present communal replaceability after removal; the same-surah creation increase of 35:1 narrows here into replacement.

topics.headline: unnamed order replaces known addressees
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the known addressed group set against an unidentified created order large enough to replace it.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite and governed in the complement phrase, while the prior object suffix is definite and addressed.

topics.headline: measured formation not mere existence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices replacement as a measured formed order, not a random filling of an empty place.
topics.reason: The verbal-noun form and root evidence support act-product-order pressure, narrowed by the local phrase so it does not become an uncontrolled dictionary list.

topics.headline: creation bound to preposition and adjective
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that creation is not detached; it is governed by the preposition and completed by the newness adjective.
topics.reason: The local grammar makes the noun the governed complement and the qualified noun, blocking a detached topic or construct reading.

topics.headline: constitution pressure without replacing local creation sense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a formed-constitution coloring while the local phrase still means a new creation.
topics.reason: The disposition branch is kept as constitution pressure only; local grammar selects the creation noun in the replacement phrase.

topics.headline: creation formula turned into replacement warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a recurring new-creation phrase shifted from resurrection dispute and creation increase into present replaceability.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete parallels at 50:15 and 35:1, and the local sequence places the phrase after removal.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive qualitative adjective making freshness or renewed newness integral to the brought creation
words.root_gloss_range: root field of newness, renewal, recent freshness, fresh-cut surface, and marked differentiation; locally the adjective defines the replacement as freshly constituted
words.prose: {{ar:جَدِيدٍۢ}} ({{tr:jadīdin}}) closes the ayah by making newness the final heard quality of the replacement. Its agreement with the creation noun keeps freshness inside the phrase, not as a loose comment, and its indefiniteness leaves the replacement unidentified except by fresh constitution. The root family can carry renewal and fresh-cut surface pressure, but the local adjective selects newness as a stable quality. Parallels at 14:19 and 50:15 make the phrase recognizable, while 35:16 lands it on the vulnerability of the present addressees; 35:17 can then point back to this whole scenario as not difficult for God.

topics.headline: newness locked to creation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that freshness defines the replacement creation rather than merely dating it.
topics.reason: The adjective agrees with the noun in case, gender, number, and indefiniteness, and the form marks a qualitative property.

topics.headline: quality without identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the replacement remains unnamed even as its freshness is made decisive.
topics.reason: The adjective is indefinite and unpossessed, supplying quality while withholding the replacement's identity.

topics.headline: fresh or renewed constitution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing newness can feel renewed or unprecedented, with fresh-surface pressure behind the adjective.
topics.reason: The root-family images survive as freshness and renewal pressure, narrowed because the local surface is an adjective modifying creation rather than a separate renewal verb.

topics.headline: final word lands on newness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah's last sound is fresh replaceability rather than the addressees' loss.
topics.reason: The adjective is the ayah's final word and shares the final phrase's genitive tanwīn cadence.

topics.headline: recognizable phrase becomes proof and warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the new-creation formula linking proof, resurrection dispute, present warning, and the next ayah's evaluation.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply concrete phrase parallels at 14:19 and 50:15, a same-surah contrast at 35:27, and the forward bridge to 35:17.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional sequence يَشَأْ / يُذْهِبْكُمْ / يَأْتِ / خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Volition initiates a five-step replacement event: the present addressees pass away, another created order arrives, and its newness is marked as occurrence after a cut rather than as simple addition.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes volition directed toward bringing a thing about and starts the replacement sequence.
Passing and going supply the departure of the current addressees.
Coming and arrival supply the opposed ingress of what follows.
Creative origination identifies the arriving term as a made order, not merely a relocated object.
New occurrence after severance gives the succession a discontinuous edge.

changed_reading.before: A generic assertion that the addressees could be destroyed and others created.
changed_reading.after: A sequenced substitution in which the present order departs, a real discontinuity occurs, and another created order arrives.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The nominal unit خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ, especially the semantic breadth of خ ل ق and ج د د.
baseline_models.mechanism: Creation can name prior measuring and the completed configuration, while newness can follow cutting. The replacement may therefore alter the constitution or design of creaturehood, not only exchange one numerically distinct cohort for another of the same form.

activation_trace.role: Measuring before action supplies a design stage for the new creation.
Completed and proportioned form makes configuration, not bare existence, part of what can be replaced.
Cutting and severance provide the operation that frees a differently measured configuration.
Renewed occurrence after the cut marks the resulting constitution as genuinely new.

changed_reading.before: New means only a later set of creatures of the same design.
changed_reading.after: New can include a remeasured and reconfigured mode of creaturehood.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately enclosing statements oppose human need to divine self-sufficiency and deny that replacement is difficult. The focus threat therefore exposes creaturely contingency: the current addressees are not indispensable to the continuation of creation.

activation_trace.role: The addressees' possible passing is the focus event whose rationale is being sharpened.
Arrival keeps creation able to continue after the present addressees pass.
Need and lack literally characterize the humans and make their replaceability an expression of dependence.
Self-sufficiency supplies the asymmetrical side that does not depend on the current population.
Difficulty and severity are explicitly negated, making replacement effortless rather than compensatory.

structural_cues: 35:15 and 35:17 syntactically enclose the focus conditional with dependence before it and lack of difficulty after it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human need, divine self-sufficiency, and negated difficulty; I infer that these explain the conditional as an independence test. A punitive warning remains a live alternative motive.

changed_reading.before: The verse is chiefly a threat of punishment against one group.
changed_reading.after: The threat also demonstrates that no creaturely group is necessary to the Creator or to creation's continuance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated uses place going beside a self spent in regret and sorrow that is taken away; later roots describe leaving a position or being displaced. This widens يُذْهِبْكُمْ from ontological erasure to removal from a present state, place, or office, though death can still be the means.

activation_trace.role: Going and passing anchor the focus verb in departure rather than specifying annihilation.
A self can literally go or be spent over others, supplying an affective analogue of departure without lexical erasure.
Regret over what has escaped explains the directional force of the nearby going event.
The same causative root removes sorrow, showing that its object can be taken out of a condition rather than unmade.
Removal from a location or state supplies the spatial-state model for what it means to be made to go.
Displacement and expulsion preserve a live social-historical mode of removal.

structural_cues: The same ذ ه ب root occurs before the focus with a self and later in the causative with sorrow, while 35:41 and 35:44 keep movement and displacement in view.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies departure, removed sorrow, loss of position, and displacement; I infer a shared removal schema for يُذْهِبْكُمْ. The stronger alternative is literal death, but even death functions here as departure from the current place in the sequence.

changed_reading.before: God would erase the addressees from existence.
changed_reading.after: God can remove the addressees from their present state, place, or role and install what follows; annihilation is possible but not lexically required.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dead earth receives life and is explicitly made an image of renewed emergence; human creation is then traced through dust and a drop. These material sequences activate a reading in which new creation can arise by reanimating and recomposing latent matter, not only by importing an unrelated population.

activation_trace.role: Creative origination is the focus anchor that can operate through revived or recomposed material.
Renewed occurrence after a break names the result of reanimation.
Loss of life supplies the apparently exhausted starting material.
The earth's life through rain and vegetation supplies material renewal rather than replacement from nowhere.
Reviving the dead after death explicitly turns the ecological sequence into a model of renewed emergence.
Dust and earth supply humble reusable material for human creation.
A drop scaling up toward abundant water supplies the small generative seed of a new creature.

structural_cues: 35:9 orders wind, cloud, dead land, enlivened earth, and renewed emergence; 35:11 orders dust, drop, pairing, gestation, and lifespan.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two creation sequences from dormant or minimal material; I map their material arrow onto خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ. An entirely different successor population remains equally possible.

changed_reading.before: The new creation is wholly other and arrives only after the old population is gone.
changed_reading.after: New creation can also be renewed life composed from matter that looked dead, slight, or exhausted.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation first admits increase, then the same ج د د root appears as visible mountain bands or paths amid repeated difference of color. Newness is thereby spatialized as a cut, patterned, perceptible differentiation, not confined to being later in time.

activation_trace.role: Completed form makes visible configuration part of the focus creation.
Temporal newness is the initial focus sense that the context reopens.
Increase and growth inside creation supply generative variation rather than mere replacement count.
The repeated creation root carries the concern with form from the surah opening into the focus.
Visible bands, plans, or paths in mountains provide the surprising spatial image for patterned novelty.
Taking divergent paths supplies differentiation among fruits and mountain bands.
Acquiring a new color makes novelty visibly inspectable in the resulting forms.

structural_cues: The root ج د د recurs as the adjective in 35:16 and as a plural noun among mountains in 35:27, where difference and color are each repeated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies root recurrence, visible bands, divergent forms, and new color; I transfer that material pattern back to the adjective as an activated secondary image. Pure chronological succession remains the syntax-first reading.

changed_reading.before: New creation means only a creation later than the current one.
changed_reading.after: New creation may also mean a freshly cut and visibly differentiated arrangement of forms, pathways, or kinds.

context_deltas.mechanism: Humans are made successors, while the governing path is said to admit no substitution or transformation. The apparent tension supports constancy through turnover: occupants of a creaturely office can be replaced precisely while the ordering pattern remains unchanged.

activation_trace.role: Departure removes the current occupants from the succession.
Arrival installs the occupants who follow.
One thing coming after another and standing in its place supplies the social office of succession.
A running path or followed practice supplies the stable rule that spans changing occupants.
One thing standing in another's place is explicitly negated for the governing path, distinguishing rule replacement from occupant replacement.
Transformation from one state to another is likewise negated for the stable path, sharpening the contrast with creaturely turnover.

structural_cues: 35:39 names the addressees as successors; 35:43 repeats سنة and pairs the negations of substitution and transformation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successor status and an invariant path; I infer that a stable system can preserve itself by replacing its officeholders. The live alternative is that 35:43 concerns only a historical punishment pattern, not the office of humanity as such.

changed_reading.before: Replacement would mean that God's plan itself changes when one people fails.
changed_reading.after: The plan can remain constant while its temporary human occupants are replaced by later bearers of the same creaturely office.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ethical unit denies that one bearer can carry another's load. Population-level replacement therefore cannot be flattened into moral substitution: a successor may occupy a vacated place without inheriting or discharging the removed group's burden.

activation_trace.role: Arrival anchors the possibility of a successor after the current bearers depart.
A heavy burden supplies the moral load that remains attached to its own bearer.
Bearing an entrusted burden supplies the transfer operation that the verse explicitly blocks.

structural_cues: 35:18 repeats bearer, burden, and carrying under negation and extends the refusal of transfer even to kin.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ontic succession in the focus and blocked burden transfer immediately after it; I distinguish replacement of occupants from substitution of accountability. The alternative is that 35:18 opens an unrelated ethical topic.

changed_reading.before: A new population might simply take over both the place and the moral account of the removed population.
changed_reading.after: Successors may take a place, but each population and person remains answerable for its own load.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cosmic bodies are held from leaving their state, restraint is named, and immediate taking-to-account is counterfactually said to leave no creature; instead people are delayed to an appointed limit. The focus conditional becomes reserved capability governed by restraint and timing, not a prediction of immediate replacement.

activation_trace.role: Volition makes removal conditional and leaves room for the restraint and timing supplied later.
Holding and confining supply active preservation against possible removal.
Leaving a place or state names the prevented cosmic analogue of the focus departure.
Forbearance and self-restraint supply the reason capability is not immediately exercised.
Vacating the earth of every creature states the unrestrained counterfactual result.
Deferral to a later time supplies the actual temporal policy instead of immediate removal.
A fixed temporal limit bounds the period of delay and preserves eventual accountability.

structural_cues: 35:45 uses a counterfactual immediate removal followed by an explicit adversative turn to delay; the focus itself begins with a condition rather than a forecast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies holding, possible removal, forbearance, universal counterfactual loss, delay, and a term; I infer that will is exercised through restraint as well as removal. The alternative is that the conditional remains only a warning about power.

changed_reading.before: The conditional signals that replacement is imminent once divine power is asserted.
changed_reading.after: Replacement is a reserved possibility whose nonexecution displays forbearance and whose execution remains tied to an appointed time.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus verb normally contributes simple arrival, yet its stranger-entering-another-people branch is exact and the context supplies passing communities and successors. Render it only as a social-spatial activation of replacement, not as the exclusive lexical meaning of يَأْتِ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The arriving term in وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ.

activation_trace.role: A stranger entering a people not his own turns generic arrival into the ingress of an outside cohort.
Occurrence after a cut separates the newcomer cohort from the departed one.
A community or kind supplies the social unit within which stranger and successor can be distinguished.
A generation's passing supplies the vacancy into which an outside cohort may arrive.
Coming after and standing in another's place turns arrival into social succession.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified new creation appears after the addressees.
changed_reading.after: A socially external cohort can be imagined entering after a community passes and taking its place.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is odd because the pronoun refers to people, but several exact focus branches form a coherent water-transfer mechanism that 35:9 and 35:27 activate. Downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for how replacement works, never as a claim that the addressees literally denote water or terrain.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The full departure-arrival-creation-newness chain, read through its rain, incoming flood, growth, and water-holding branches.

activation_trace.role: Rainfall supplies the departing or spent water phase of the material analogy.
A flood arriving from another land supplies transferred water as the replacement input.
Emergent growth and yield convert incoming material into new living output.
A hollow or newly dug well that retains water supplies the receptive structure enabling renewal.
Rain giving life to earth confirms that transferred water can generate a successor ecology.
Delivering water by pouring or irrigation completes the hydraulic causal chain.

changed_reading.before: Replacement is an abstract exchange of populations.
changed_reading.after: Replacement can be pictured materially as imported water entering a receptive terrain and reseeding life after an exhausted phase.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because plural removal and an indefinite creation most naturally indicate populations, but خ ل ق explicitly includes inward disposition and the context tracks altered moral perception and aversion. Preserve it as a secondary psychological layer, not as a replacement for the population-level syntax.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ as a potentially renewed inward nature or disposition.

activation_trace.role: Inward nature and disposition allow creation to name a moral constitution as well as a population.
Renewal after a break supplies the possibility of a changed inner constitution.
Making evil appear beautiful supplies a manipulable moral-perceptual surface.
The heart's opinion and reflection locate the distortion within appraisal rather than outer form.
Aversion and distancing show a disposition becoming more resistant when warning arrives.

changed_reading.before: Only one set of persons is removed and another set created.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory inner layer, a corrupted mode of appraisal could give way to a newly constituted disposition.

strongest_changes: Repeated movement roots revise removal from mandatory annihilation to departure from a state, place, or office.
The mountain use of ج د د reactivates newness as visible patterned differentiation as well as temporal succession.
Human successor status and an invariant governing path together produce a model of stable order through replaceable occupants.
Forbearance, delay, and an appointed term turn the focus conditional into reserved power rather than imminent prediction.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots recur in sharply different material and social settings, so three readings remain live without merger: replacement by another cohort, renewal or repatterning from latent matter, and an exploratory renewal of disposition. The strongest surprise is that جَدِيد is re-seen through the visible جُدَد of 35:27 while the stable سنة of 35:43 can still operate by changing its human occupants.
remaining_uncertainties: The patterned reading depends on carrying the 35:27 mountain-band branch back into an adjective whose syntax still favors ordinary temporal newness.
The successor-office model may extend a historical punishment pattern beyond the narrower force of 35:43.
The hydraulic and psychological outliers are coherent branch activations but remain analogical rather than syntax-leading readings.
The branchless ك ي ف occurrences in 35:26 and 35:44 can frame comparison and outcome structurally but cannot support branch citations.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ekin ve hurmanın ürünü, gelişmesi ve bol verimi ile suyun çoğalmasını destekler. Çalkalanan tulumdan yağın çıkması ise yalnız ayrı kalıbın kaynak ifadesiyle açıklanabilen, çekirdeğe bağlı olmayan bir kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bitkisel ürün ve artış çekirdektir; suyun çoğalması uzantı, tulumdan yağ çıkması ise ayrı kalıp kullanımıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ürün ve gelişme bildiren biçim, suyun çoğalması ve çalkalanan tulumda yağın belirmesini bildiren kalıptan ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Ekin ve hurmanın gelişip ürün vermesi, ürününün ve veriminin bol olmasıdır; suyun çoğalması da bu artış alanına uzanır. Ayrı bir kalıp, çalkalanan tulumda yağın ortaya çıkmasını bildirir.

facets.statement: Ekin veya hurma gelişir, ürün verir ve verimi artar.
Suyun miktarı çoğalır.
Ayrı bir kalıpta çalkalanan tulumun yağı ortaya çıkar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt bitkisel gelişme, ürün ve bol verimi merkez alır; su artışı ve tulum yağının belirmesi farklı kapsamlı kullanımlardır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ekin veya hurmanın gelişmesi, ürün çıkarması ve veriminin artması birlikte anlatılacağında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bitkisel gelişme, ürün ve bolluk çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ekinin veya hurmanın çıkan ürünü ve yüksek verimi adlandırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bitkinin ürünü ile verim bolluğunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Gelişme sürecini, suyun çoğalmasını ve tulum yağı kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ekin ve hurmanın gelişmesi, ürünü ve bol verimi

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ürünle birlikte gelişme ve bolluk sürecini öne çıkarır; komşu dal ürünün kendisine daha genel biçimde yönelir.

branches.what_is_ar: ريع الزرع والنخل وثمرهما، وكثرة الماء، وما يجيء من زبد السقاء عند الصحاح والمفردات

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yönetime ödenen vergi veya baş vergisini ortak alan olarak verir ve aynı toplu iddia içinde bir kişiye sunulan rüşvet kullanımını da bildirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Düzenli veya zorunlu kamu ödemesi çekirdektir; rüşvet, aynı biçimin ayrı kalıptaki özel kullanımıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Vergi adı olarak kullanılan biçim ile birine rüşvet vermeyi bildiren kalıp kapsam bakımından ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğun veya kişinin yönetime ödediği vergi ya da baş vergisidir. Ayrı bir kalıpta, bir kimseye çıkar sağlamak için verilen rüşveti veya rüşvet verme eylemini anlatır.

facets.statement: Topluluk veya kişi yönetime vergi niteliğinde para öder.
Ödeme baş vergisi veya benzeri yükümlülük niteliği taşır.
Ayrı bir kullanımda bir kimseye rüşvet verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu iddia vergi ve baş vergisi anlamlarını ortaklaştırır; rüşvet kullanımı kaynaklara ayrı ayrı dağıtılamayan özel bir karşılık olarak aynı iddiada yer alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yönetime ödenen mali yükümlülük ile ayrı rüşvet kullanımı birlikte gösterileceğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Vergi, baş vergisi ve ayrı rüşvet kullanımını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Topluluğun veya kişinin yönetime yaptığı zorunlu mali ödeme söz konusu olduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yönetime yapılan mali yükümlülük ödemesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Rüşvet olarak verilen ödeme kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir kişi veya topluluğa yüklenen vergi ve kamu ödemesi alanında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal vergi adının yanında rüşvet kullanımına sahiptir; komşu dal ise üzerine konan mali yükümlülük türlerini daha geniş kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yarışın son sınırı, işlek ya da yürünmüş yol, yol kavşağı ve bir evin karşısında veya hizasında olma kullanımlarını açıkça destekler.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yol ve son sınır bildiren adlar ile bir evin karşısında bulunmayı bildiren kalıp ayrı kapsamlar olarak korunur.

facets.statement: İnsanların kullandığı işlek veya yürünmüş ana yol adlandırılır.

Yarış atlarının koşusunun ulaştığı son sınır adlandırılır.
Bir yapı başka bir yapının karşısında veya aynı hizasında bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt yol, kavşak ve yarış sonu anlamlarını; ayrıca yapıların karşı karşıya veya aynı hizada oluşunu bildiren kalıbı bir araya getirir.

concept_gloss.text: işlek ana yol, son sınır ve karşı hizası

error_profile.preserves: Yol, kavşak, yarış sonu ve konumsal hizalama kapsamlarını korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli kalıplarda kişiye ölüm, ağır hastalık, bela veya kırık gelmesini; malın yok olmasını; kişinin öldürülüp götürülmesini ve düşmanın yaklaşmasını destekler. Genel olarak gelişin iyi veya kötü olabileceği notu, bu dalın yalnız zararlı kalıplarını genişletmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız belirtilen zarar ve tehdit kalıplarına bağlıdır; genel gelme eylemi veya her türlü yok oluş değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ölüm, hastalık, mal kaybı, yenilgi ve düşman yaklaşması anlamları yalnız kendi kalıplarında korunur.

concept_map.definition: Belirli kalıplarda bir kişiye ölüm, ağır hastalık, bela veya kırık gelmesi; malının yok olması; öldürülüp götürülmesi ya da düşmanın ona yaklaşmasıdır.

facets.statement: Kişi ölüm, ağır hastalık, bela veya uzuv kırılması gibi ağır bir zarara uğrar.
Bir kişinin malı yok olur.
Bir kişi öldürülür, götürülür veya üzerinde üstünlük kurulur.
Düşman kişiye yaklaşır ve tehdit oluşturur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, farklı kalıplarda kişisel felaket, mal kaybı, öldürülme veya götürülme ve yaklaşan düşman tehdidini sıralar; genel gelişin olumlu da olabileceği ayrıca belirtilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, bir kişinin bir iş veya sonuç için uygun, yaraşır ve bunu yapması beklenebilir durumda olmasını ortak anlam olarak verir. Hazırlanmış olmak bu uygunluğu açıklayan bir benzetmedir; gerçek bir hazırlık işlemi zorunlu değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yaraşırlık ve güçlü uygunluk bildirir; gerçekleşmiş eylemi veya yalnızca hazırlanmayı bildirmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam, kişi ile beklenen iş arasındaki yapıya bağlı uygunlukta gerçekleşir; yalın bir hazırlık anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin bir işi yapmaya veya bir niteliği taşımaya yaraşır, uygun ve bunu yapması beklenebilir durumda olmasıdır.

facets.statement: Kişi ile ona bağlanan iş veya nitelik arasında güçlü bir uygunluk vardır.
Bu uygunluk, kişinin söz konusu iş için hazırlanmış gibi görülmesiyle açıklanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yaraşırlık, uygunluk ve bir eylemin kişiden güçlü biçimde beklenmesi üzerinde birleşir; hazırlanmış veya o özellik için yaratılmış olma benzetmesi bu yargıyı açıklar.

concept_gloss.text: bir şeye yaraşır ve uygun olma
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişi veya durumun belirli bir eylem ya da iyilik için güçlü biçimde uygun görüldüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yaraşırlık, uygunluk ve beklenebilirlik öğelerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin belirli bir işi yapmaya güçlü biçimde yatkın veya uygun görüldüğü cümlelerde doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Eylemin kişiden güçlü biçimde beklenmesi anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir niteliğe ya da iyiliğe yaraşır olma kapsamını daraltır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: iyiliğe veya o işe çok uygun

error_profile.preserves: Bir işe uygun durumda bulunma düşüncesini kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Yaraşırlık ve eylemin kişiden beklenmesi yargılarını kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Gerçek bir hazırlık sürecinin tamamlandığı anlamını ekler.
error_profile.collision: Değer ve uygunluk yargısını uygulamalı hazırlıkla karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir eylemi yapmanın kişiye uygun ve ondan beklenebilir olduğunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın kapsamı nitelik ve iyiliğe de açılır; komşu dal belirli bir eylemin gerçekleşme yakınlığına daha sıkı bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişinin işe yaraşır ve onu yapması beklenir olduğunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişi veya nesnenin eylem için gerçekten hazırlanıp uygun hale getirilmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir iş için uygun durumda bulunma düşüncesine yaklaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bir değerlendirme ve beklentidir; komşu dal hazırlama veya hazırlanma sürecini gerektirir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; tam eşdeğer yaraşırlık dalı, eyleme özgü beklenti ve gerçek hazırlanma arasındaki üçlü ayrım yayıma değer bulundu.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه خليق بكذا، أخلق به، مخلقة للخير، وما يكون الشخص كأنه مهيأ أو مقدر لذلك.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımının baskın çekirdeği kişiye ayrılan pay, özellikle iyilik ve öte dünya bakımından düşen paydır. İyiliğe istek, düzgün yaşayış ve kişinin huyuyla kazandığı erdem açıklamaları pay düşüncesini yorumlayan veya genişleten kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Pay çekirdeği korunur; iyiliğin kendisi, inanç yolu veya kazanılmış erdem onunla doğrudan özdeşleştirilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad payı bildirir; payın bulunmadığını söyleyen yapı ve iyilik alanındaki yorumlar kendi kullanım sınırlarında tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Kişiye ayrılmış paydır; özellikle iyilikten veya öte dünyadaki karşılıktan ona düşen bölümü anlatır. İyiliğe yöneliş, düzgün yaşayış ve huyla kazanılmış erdem kimi açıklamalarda bu payın niteliği olarak öne çıkar.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye ayrılmış ve onun payına düşmüş bir bölüm vardır.
Pay özellikle iyilik ve öte dünyadaki karşılık bakımından değerlendirilir.
İyiliğe istek, düzgün yaşayış veya huyla kazanılmış erdem de pay kavramını açıklayan değerler olarak verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların çoğu ayrılmış pay ve özellikle iyilikten düşen bölüm üzerinde birleşir; iyiliğe yönelme, düzgün yaşayış ve kazanılmış erdem bu çekirdeğin farklı açıklamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin iyilikten veya öte dünyadaki karşılıktan sahip olduğu ya da olmadığı payı anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Ayrılmış pay ilişkisini ve iyilik alanındaki özel kapsamı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin iyilik veya öte dünyadaki karşılık bakımından hiçbir pay taşımadığını söyleyen yapıda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Payın yokluğunu ve payın iyilik alanıyla ilişkisini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: iyilikten veya öte dünyadaki karşılıktan payı yok

error_profile.preserves: Payın değerlendirildiği olumlu değer alanını korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir kişiye ayrılmış bölüm ve o bölümün kişiye düşmesi ilişkisini kaybeder.
error_profile.collision: Payın konusu olan iyilikle payın kendisini birbirine karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal iyiliği bir kişiye düşen pay olarak kurar; komşu dal iyilik eylem ve tutumlarını doğrudan adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İnanç ve iyilik alanında kişiye düşen payı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İzlenen inanç yolunu ve kurallar bütününü doğrudan adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bazı açıklamalar iki dalı doğru yaşayış ve inanç alanında yan yana getirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal kişinin payını ölçer; komşu dal kişinin bağlı olduğu inanç ve yaşayış yolunu gösterir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Sunulan bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; iyiliğin kendisi ile izlenen inanç yolu, pay çekirdeğinin en kolay karışabileceği iki alan olduğu için seçildi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı gerçeğe dayanmayan sözü zihinde kurma, uydurma ve doğruymuş gibi ortaya atma üzerinde birleşir. Yanlış kişiye bağlanan şiir ve asılsız anlatılar, yalan üretme eyleminin sonuç ve ürünleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal gerçek bir şeyi meydana getirmeyi değil, gerçeği olmayan söz veya anlatı üretmeyi bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalan uydurma çekirdeği korunur; söz, asılsız anlatı ve yanlış bağlama ilişkin yapılar yalnız kendi kalıplarında uygulanır.

concept_map.definition: Gerçeklik temeli olmadan zihinde bir söz veya anlatı kurup onu doğruymuş gibi ortaya atmaktır. Yanlış kişiye bağlanan şiirler ve uydurma anlatılar bu eylemin ürünleridir.

facets.statement: Gerçeği olmayan bir söz veya anlatı tasarlanıp üretilir.
Uydurma, sözün önce zihinde kurulup biçimlendirilmesiyle ilişkilendirilir.
Yanlış kişiye bağlanan şiir ve asılsız anlatı, üretilmiş yalanın ürünü olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yalan sözü uydurma, zihinde kurma ve ortaya atma çekirdeğinde birleşir; yanlış bağlama ve asılsız anlatılar bu üretimin belirgin sonuçlarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Gerçeğe dayanmayan bir söz, haber veya anlatının bilinçli biçimde kurulmasını anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Hem uydurma işlemini hem ortaya çıkan yalan içeriği korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gerçek olmayan bir sözün veya haberin bilinçli biçimde üretildiği cümlelerde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gerçeğe dayanmayan sözü kurma eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yanlış kişiye bağlama ve uydurma anlatı ürünlerini kapsam dışında bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Asılsız öykü ve haberlerin ürün olarak topluca adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Uydurma eyleminin asılsız anlatı ürününü korur.

error_profile.loses: Yalanı zihinde kurma, üretme ve yanlış kişiye bağlama işlemlerini kaybeder.
error_profile.collision: Hazır bir yanlış bildirimle bilinçli uydurma sürecini ayırt etmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Uydurma sözün zihinde kurulmasını, asılsız anlatıları ve yanlış kişiye bağlamayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yalanı suçlama, ortak koşma ve haksızlık gibi belirli alanlara genişletir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da gerçeğe aykırı sözün bilinçli biçimde uydurulmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal söz ve anlatı üretme sürecine odaklanır; komşu dal uydurmanın suçlama ve ağır yanlışlık alanındaki kullanımlarını da içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Asılsız içeriği üretme ve doğruymuş gibi ortaya atma eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aslı veya düzeni bulunmayan anlatıların kendisini ürün olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Uydurulan asılsız anlatılar iki dalın ortak alanını oluşturur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal üretme eylemini de içerir; komşu dal daha çok ortaya çıkmış asılsız anlatı türüne odaklanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Zihinde kurulan içeriğin gerçeğe aykırı bir söz olması gerekir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gerçek bir nesnenin ölçüsünü ve uygulama sınırlarını belirler.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da eylemden önce zihinde bir düzen kurma düşüncesi bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda kurulan şey gerçeğe aykırı sözdür; komşu dalda gerçek nesneye uygulanacak ölçü ve sınırdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; yakın uydurma dalı, uydurma anlatı ürünü ve aynı kökün gerçek ölçme dalı anlamın eylem, ürün ve doğruluk sınırlarını en iyi gösterdi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı yüzeyin engebesiz, düz ve kimi örneklerde yoğun olmasını ortak çekirdek yapar. Düzleştirme eylemi, taş ve araçların pürüzsüzlüğü, bulutun yayılıp düzleşmesi ve izin yere karışması bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yüzey niteliği ve düzleştirmeyle sınırlıdır; aşınma yalnız bu niteliğe yol açtığında bağlantılıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın yüzey düzgünlüğünü karşılar; eskime, koku veya özel kalıp anlamları bu dala alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir yüzeyin engebesiz, düz ve kimi nesnelerde yoğun olması ya da sürtme ve düzeltmeyle bu duruma getirilmesidir.

facets.statement: Yüzey engebesiz, düzgün ve kesintisizdir.
İp, yay kirişi, ok veya benzeri bir nesne düzeltilerek bu yüzey niteliğine kavuşturulur.
Düz kaya, yayılmış bulut, yere karışmış iz ve bedenin düz bölgesi bu niteliğin örnekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar düz ve engebesiz yüzey çekirdeğinde birleşir; taş, ok, ip, beden bölgesi, bulut ve yere karışan iz bu niteliğin nesne ve durumlara göre çeşitlenen örnekleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir yüzeyin doğal olarak ya da düzeltme sonucunda çıkıntısız ve düzgün olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yüzeyin engebesiz ve düz olması çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İp, ok, tahta veya benzeri bir nesnenin yüzeyini işleyerek düzgün hale getirme bağlamına uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yüzeyi işleyerek engebesiz hale getirme eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Doğal düz yüzeyleri ve bulut ya da izin kendiliğinden düzleşmesini dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: alnın veya gözler arasının düz bölümü

error_profile.preserves: İşlenmiş bir yüzeyin gözle algılanan niteliğini kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Engebesizlik, düzlük ve yüzeyin kesintisiz olması özelliklerini kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Işığı güçlü biçimde yansıtma özelliği ekler.
error_profile.collision: Düz bir yüzeyle ışıldayan bir yüzeyi birbirine karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Düzlüğü bulut, iz, ok, ip ve belirli beden bölümleri gibi geniş örneklere uygular.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yüzeyde iz bulunmaması, tüy yokluğu ve sürtünmeyle aşınma gibi özel sonuçları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalın ortak çekirdeği engebesiz ve düzgün yüzeydir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal genel düzlük ve düzleştirmeyi öne çıkarır; komşu dal iz, tüy veya yüzey kalıntısının yokluğuna daha fazla uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Doğal yüzey niteliğini ve küçük nesnelerin düzeltilmesini de kapsar.
